quarterly_data.quarter: Chenming Electronic Tech IR presentation: MOPS 301320261001E001 (10-01-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Products: OEM chassis for CSP platforms (Tioga Pass, Yosemite V1-V5, Grand Canyon V1/V2, the Zion System, Grand Teton) and AI racks (GB200/300 NVL72, VR200 NVL72, ASIC racks, sidecar, RPU, G893/G894); off-the-shelf chassis on an NVIDIA MGX roadmap from 2024 to 2029 (MGX 2U/4U, MGX GB300 NVL72, MGX VR200 NVL72, MGX Rubin NVL8, MGX 1U NVLink Switch, MGX STX storage, then MGX Vera Rubin Ultra chassis and Kyber chassis); OCP DC-MHS and Intel Edge-MHS chassis.

quarterly_data.quarter: Chenming Electronic Tech IR presentation: MOPS 301320261001E001 (10-01-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Racks and power: rack ODM for OCP ORv3 racks (27, 48, 52OU) and EIA racks (42, 48, 52RU) with manifolds, busbar and PDUs; off-the-shelf racks include RDHx, AALC (50kw), immersion tank (demo), ORv3 HPR, MGX v1.1/v1.2, power rack, ORW rack and mini rack. The Uneec EIA UltimaRack for AI data centers supports direct-to-chip cold plates, manifolds, UQD and CDU, 600A to 1400A+ busbar and 800V or +/- 400V HVDC, with a 2000 kg payload.
quarterly_data.figure: UltimaRack: 600A to 1400A+ busbar, 800V or +/- 400V HVDC, 2000 kg payload

quarterly_data.quarter: Chenming Electronic Tech IR presentation: MOPS 301320261001E001 (10-01-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: New development: liquid-cooling manifold design and manufacturing (Class 8 cleanroom, X-ray / CT weld inspection), L11 liquid-cooling system integration (CDU, sidecar and tank OEM; in-rack CDU assembly line and liquid-to-air sidecar assembly), RPU, L2A sidecar and containerized modular data centers (CMDC). Manufacturing bases: Dongguan (150,000 m2, 2,600 employees), Ningbo (57,500 m2, 1,700), Thailand Apex Green Industrial Estate (111,066 m2, 180) and Zhongli, Taoyuan (11,000 m2).
